newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugo c.bank extends short-term bonds issue.
newsitem.headline: Yugo c.bank extends short-term bonds issue.

text.p: The National Bank of Yugoslavia (NBY) on Wednesday extended to 100 million dinars ($16.9 million) the volume of its 60-million dinars issue of short-term bonds auctioned on July 8, the Belgrade bourse said.

"The 60-million dinars tranche was sold in three days and there was a significant demand for more. The fast sale prompted the NBY to extend by another 40 million dinars the tranche which matures on July 28," the bourse's spokesperson said.
The NBY short-term bonds carry a three percent interest rate a month which corresponds to an annual 41.63 percent.
Money raised from the sale is used for stimulating production in agriculture.
The NBY on Wednesday sold 11.5 million dinars worth of the extended volume of 40 million dinars, the bourse said.
